recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not restore the 2015 required targetDisease/doseStatus rule in the current build; FHIR-19487 and the protocolApplied redesign supersede that DSTU-era cardinality intent.
issue_request: FHIR-7519 was a Published PHER change request from the 2015May/DSTU-era Immunization model. It asked to allow vaccination protocol dose sequence to be recorded without doseTarget or doseStatus; the final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept target disease meaningful/required, said doseStatus should likewise be declared, and renamed doseTarget to targetedDisease/targetDisease.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in the old spreadsheet source: commit 4e6d62c693 changed Immunization.vaccinationProtocol.doseTarget to 1..*, and commit e43671d5b7 renamed doseTarget to targetDisease. The old examples also carried targetDisease and doseStatus in vaccinationProtocol.
additional_context: Later PHER decisions changed the current model. FHIR-8406 removed the old vaccinationProtocol backbone and moved evaluation content out of Immunization; FHIR-14536 and FHIR-18868 reintroduced a smaller protocolApplied backbone for provider intent/dose metadata; FHIR-19487 explicitly lowered Immunization.protocolApplied.targetDisease to 0..* after implementer feedback that dose number is often available without target disease.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current active source lists Immunization in source/fhir.ini, has Immunization.protocolApplied.targetDisease as 0..*, has doseNumber present, and has no active doseStatus/doseStatusReason or old doseTarget elements under source/immunization.
